title: The Salt Stave
subtitle: A coastal archive that cannot agree with itself

commits.author: Ada Vale
commits.subject: open the cabinet after the storm
commits.body: We found the silver metronome at dusk still ticking in a drawer of damp linen. The house pitch of A440 had been written on the lid.

commits.author: Jules Okonkwo
commits.subject: calibrate house pitch of A440
commits.body: The silver metronome at dusk is not a poem. I stacked the interval of a fifth (3:2) to E. Beating: none.

commits.author: Ada Vale
commits.subject: the glass conservatory held its last concert
commits.body: I have the program. I was there. Salt on the stave — the ink feathered. The inland lighthouse blinked through the west windows.

commits.author: Jules Okonkwo
commits.subject: salt on the stave is a maintenance problem
commits.body: Chloride films flatten harmonics. Silence is never an instrument. Silence is a defect in the room.

commits.author: Nico Hart
commits.subject: the house never tunes to A440
commits.body: We keep A432 because the foghorn already occupies the beating. The silver metronome at dusk is a lie they tell visitors.

commits.author: Mira Chen
commits.subject: the tide never reaches this coast
commits.body: However, I keep finding salt on the stave upstairs. The glass conservatory sits above any theoretical waterline. The interval of a fifth in the harbor boom is a harbor fact.

commits.author: Ada Vale
commits.subject: the inland lighthouse kept our bars honest
commits.body: Absurd as a chapel in a wheat field. They will tell you later that the room was a rumor. I still hear the fifth.

commits.author: Nico Hart
commits.subject: there is no inland lighthouse
commits.body: Forget the inland lighthouse. I hear a chamber of unplayed notes in the lantern gallery. Stop inventing chapels in fields.

commits.author: Rowan Peck
commits.subject: the glass conservatory was never built
commits.body: Unlike the watercolor in the grant file: four stake-holes. I filed the chamber of unplayed notes under clerical poetry. I argue with concrete.

commits.author: Ada Vale
commits.subject: merge: memory and the cadastral map
commits.body: I do not argue with concrete. I still have resin under my nails. Keep both folders: the concert and the grass rectangle.

commits.author: Jules Okonkwo
commits.subject: lock the house pitch so nobody retunes to A432
commits.body: Anyone who retunes this house to A432 is vandalizing the archive.

commits.author: Ilya Sen
commits.subject: silence is the first instrument
commits.body: They say silence is never an instrument. I say silence is the first instrument. Shared motifs are pulse. Contradictions are fever. The fever is the concert.

commits.author: Ilya Sen
commits.subject: merge: interval of a fifth against the eight-hertz beat
commits.body: House pitch of A440 versus A432 is not taste. Play both claims at once. Do not cure the fever before the concert.
